Class AudiobookSimplified

java.lang.Object
se.michaelthelin.spotify.model_objects.AbstractModelObject
se.michaelthelin.spotify.model_objects.specification.AudiobookSimplified
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, IModelObject
public class AudiobookSimplified extends AbstractModelObject
Retrieve information about simplified Audiobook objects by building instances from this class.
